DISCONNECTED — Jun 5 2026

Google Drive connector disconnected pending compliance and IT review. Claude had access to ALL company Shared Drives including Bank, Renewals, S Drive, client folders, policy records and personal financial data.

Do NOT reconnect until:
- IT/compliance approves Claude AI access to Google Workspace
- Dedicated ILIA CIH Shared Drive is created

See JIRA NIWD-1734 for full details.

COMPLIANCE HOLD — Google Drive Disconnected (Jun 5 2026)

Google Drive connector disconnected pending internal compliance and IT review. Issue: Claude had access to ALL company Shared Drives including Bank, Renewals, S Drive, client folders, policy records, and personal financial data.

This requires sign-off before reconnecting:
- IT/compliance approval for connecting Google Workspace to Claude AI
- Data classification review (client PII, insurance records, financial data)
- Formal data processing agreement with Anthropic if required
- Scoped reconnection — only ILIA Central Intelligence Shared Drive once created

Action: Jamin to raise with IT/compliance team. Do NOT reconnect full Drive until approved.

Resolution path: Create dedicated ILIA CIH Shared Drive → get compliance sign-off → reconnect only that drive.

Can we add the function of Claude prompts interaction with Node, Bitbucket to allow users to work in ILIA and see updates on a browser real time. Users communicate only in Claude for these requirements, to update ILIA code on local machines, and the setup requirements for this for users of the ILIA CIH.
